mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM apms_athlete WHERE status = '0') AS athlete_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM apms_test_task WHERE status = 'IN_PROGRESS') AS task_in_progress_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM apms_test_task WHERE status = 'PENDING') AS task_pending_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM apms_test_task WHERE status = 'COMPLETED') AS task_completed_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM apms_rtp_status WHERE status = 'y') AS rtp_yellow_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM apms_rtp_status WHERE status = 'r') AS rtp_red_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM apms_rtp_status WHERE status = 'g') AS rtp_green_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM apms_body_measure WHERE measure_date >= DATE(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY))) AS body_measure_week_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM apms_phv_record WHERE measure_date >= DATE(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY))) AS phv_week_count, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(dept_name SEPARATOR ' · ') FROM sys_dept WHERE dept_type = '20' AND status = '0' AND del_flag = '0') AS team_list FROM dual

SELECT t.id AS task_id, t.task_name AS task_name, t.status AS status, t.start_date AS start_date, t.end_date AS end_date, d.dept_name AS team_name, COUNT(m.athlete_id) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(m.athlete_id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(m.athlete_id)) END AS progress FROM apms_test_task t LEFT JOIN apms_task_member m ON t.id = m.task_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON t.target_dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE t.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' GROUP BY t.id, t.task_name, t.status, t.start_date, t.end_date, d.dept_name ORDER BY t.start_date ASC

SELECT r.athlete_id AS athlete_id, a.name AS athlete_name, a.jersey_no AS jersey_no, a.position AS position, r.status AS status, r.reason AS reason, r.training_limit AS training_limit, r.next_review_date AS next_review_date FROM apms_rtp_status r LEFT JOIN apms_athlete a ON r.athlete_id = a.athlete_id WHERE r.status IN ('y', 'r') ORDER BY CASE r.status WHEN 'r' THEN 0 WHEN 'y' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, r.next_review_date ASC
